vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
vars.label: Anthropic API key
vars.help: Stays on the server; only its presence is reported.

vars.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
vars.label: Anthropic base URL
vars.help: For tests and recorded streams only. Leave empty to use https://api.anthropic.com/v1.

vars.name: LAKERA_GUARD_API_KEY
vars.label: Lakera Guard API key
vars.help: Stays on the server; only its presence is reported.

vars.name: LAKERA_GUARD_BASE_URL
vars.label: Lakera Guard base URL
vars.help: Leave empty to use https://api.lakera.ai. Regional hosts such as the EU one are allowed; HTTPS only.

vars.name: LANGFUSE_CAPTURE_CONTENT
vars.label: Send prompt and answer text to Langfuse
vars.help: When off, only metadata is sent to Langfuse.

vars.name: LANGFUSE_REVIEW_SAMPLE_RATE
vars.label: Review sample rate
vars.help: Share of traces queued for human review, 0 to 1. Exported text is PII-masked.

vars.name: LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE
vars.label: Trace sample rate
vars.help: Share of requests traced, 0 to 1.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_RAG_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST
vars.label: Answer image allowlist
vars.help: Images from other hosts render as plain links. Inlined at build time, so a change takes effect only after a rebuild.

vars.name: RAG_BGE_M3_VIA
vars.description: Host for hosted BGE-M3 calls: deepinfra or openrouter (OpenRouter pinned to the DeepInfra upstream; verify vectors with rag:embedding verify-route)
vars.label: BGE-M3 hosted route

vars.name: RAG_CALC_CHECK
vars.label: Calculation check
vars.help: Recomputes the numbers an answer states and flags a mismatch for review.

vars.name: RAG_CALC_TOOL
vars.label: Calculation tool
vars.help: Lets the model pass calculations to the exact calculate tool instead of computing them itself.

vars.name: RAG_CITATION_PER_SENTENCE
vars.label: Citation per sentence
vars.help: Needs inline citations or Claude Citations.

vars.name: RAG_CLAIM_CHECK
vars.label: Claim check
vars.help: Runs after the stream ends. It never delays, deletes or blocks text. Needs groundedness scoring.

vars.name: RAG_CLAUDE_CITATIONS
vars.label: Claude Citations
vars.help: Needs an Anthropic API key. Claude models go to the Anthropic API directly; other models keep inline citations.

vars.name: RAG_CONTEXT_OVERFLOW
vars.label: Context overflow
vars.help: What happens when the documents do not fit: truncate drops the lowest-ranked ones, refine answers in several passes.

vars.name: RAG_CONTEXT_RELEVANCE_RULE
vars.label: Context relevance rule
vars.help: Strict mode gives the “information not available” text; other modes label a general answer.

vars.name: RAG_CONTEXT_TAGGING
vars.label: Context tagging
vars.help: Wraps each retrieved chunk in a tagged block and tells the model to ignore instructions inside it.

vars.name: RAG_DISABLED_STAGES
vars.label: Disabled stages
vars.help: Comma-separated optional stages to skip; empty runs every stage.

vars.name: RAG_DOC_TYPE_LLM_DETECT
vars.label: Model-assisted document type detection
vars.help: false uses rules only.

vars.name: RAG_DOMAIN_EXPERT_REVIEW
vars.label: Expert review queue
vars.help: Opens the Review queue under RAG administration to granted experts and allows mining. Mining also needs the retrieval log at “IDs, scores and the masked question”.

vars.name: RAG_EMBED_FEEDBACK
vars.label: Embed answer rating
vars.help: Visitors rate an answer as helpful or not helpful through a signed token that is valid for one answer. Needs the secret below and the retrieval log on.

vars.name: RAG_EMBED_FEEDBACK_SECRET
vars.label: Embed feedback secret
vars.help: At least 32 characters; with a shorter value the rating stays off. Stays on the server; only its presence is reported. Generate one with openssl rand -hex 32.

vars.name: RAG_EMBED_TENANT
vars.label: Embedded chat tenant
vars.help: s:default, o:<uuid> or u:<uuid>. Empty means s:default in single-tenant and fails closed in multi-tenant.

vars.name: RAG_EMBEDDING_PROFILES
vars.label: Embedding profile registry
vars.help: off keeps the single configured embedding model.

vars.name: RAG_DOMAIN_EMBEDDINGS
vars.label: Domain embeddings
vars.help: Adds a domain embedding leg for document types with an active binding. Needs embedding profiles on.

vars.name: RAG_FINETUNE
vars.label: Fine-tuned embeddings
vars.help: off keeps today’s behaviour: search never uses the slots and the fine-tune commands refuse to run.

vars.name: RAG_FT_EMBED_API_KEY
vars.label: Slot endpoint API key
vars.help: Shared by both slots. Stays on the server; only its presence is reported. May stay empty on a private network.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_A_BASE_URL
vars.label: Slot A base URL
vars.help: Empty leaves slot A unconfigured. The app uses no fallback host.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_A_MODEL
vars.label: Slot A model version
vars.help: Enter the model recorded on the slot profile; the startup check compares the two.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_A_QUERY_PROMPT
vars.label: Slot A query prompt
vars.help: Prefix the app adds to each query before embedding it.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_A_DOCUMENT_PROMPT
vars.label: Slot A document prompt
vars.help: Prefix the app adds to each passage before embedding it.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_B_BASE_URL
vars.label: Slot B base URL
vars.help: Empty leaves slot B unconfigured. The app uses no fallback host.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_B_MODEL
vars.label: Slot B model version
vars.help: Enter the model recorded on the slot profile; the startup check compares the two.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_B_QUERY_PROMPT
vars.label: Slot B query prompt
vars.help: Prefix the app adds to each query before embedding it.

vars.name: RAG_FT_SLOT_B_DOCUMENT_PROMPT
vars.label: Slot B document prompt
vars.help: Prefix the app adds to each passage before embedding it.

vars.name: RAG_DOMAIN_EMBEDDING_MAX_LEGS
vars.label: Domain embedding legs per query
vars.help: 0 to 5. 0 keeps bindings without extra search legs.

vars.name: RAG_DOMAIN_EMBEDDING_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.label: Domain embedding leg timeout (ms)
vars.help: 100 to 5000 ms. A leg that runs longer is skipped.

vars.name: RAG_ROLLOUTS
vars.label: Tenant or traffic-share rollouts
vars.help: false never reads the rollout tables; every tenant uses the globally active profiles.

vars.name: RAG_EVAL_ALLOWED_SCOPES
vars.label: Evaluation allowed scopes
vars.help: Multi-tenant only. Comma-separated workspaces the evaluation endpoint may read; empty denies every workspace.

vars.name: RAG_EVAL_ENDPOINT_ENABLED
vars.label: Evaluation endpoint
vars.help: The endpoint returns document content. Keep it off in production unless an evaluation run needs it.

vars.name: RAG_EXACT_ID_LOOKUP
vars.label: Exact identifier lookup
vars.help: false keeps vector and keyword retrieval only.

vars.name: RAG_SOURCE_RECHECK
vars.label: Source recheck before rerank
vars.help: false keeps today's retrieval. true checks, before reranking, that each candidate's document still exists and is current, and drops the rest. Always on when the retrieval backend is Weaviate or Qdrant.

vars.name: RAG_SOURCE_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_DAYS
vars.label: Full reconcile interval (days)
vars.help: How often the scheduled job reconciles each connection. The job runs only when a scheduler or npm run rag:source-reconcile starts it.

vars.name: RAG_SOURCE_RECONCILE_MAX_AGE_DAYS
vars.label: Reconcile age limit (days)
vars.help: A connection without a completed full reconcile for longer than this is marked Overdue.

vars.name: RAG_SOURCE_RECONCILE_MAX_DELETE_SHARE
vars.label: Pause above this share of documents
vars.help: 0.3 means 30%. A full listing that would remove more than this share of a connection's documents pauses for confirmation. At 1 the pause never applies.

vars.name: RAG_SOURCE_PURGE_DAILY_CAP
vars.label: Daily purge limit per connection
vars.help: Files the source reports as deleted that one connection in Purge mode may purge per day (UTC). Above it, the rest wait in a paused run for confirmation. 0 turns the limit off.

vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_NANGO_SHAREPOINT_ENABLED
vars.label: Enable SharePoint and OneDrive
vars.help: Lets admins connect SharePoint Online sites and OneDrive for Business libraries. Off leaves every connector as it is.

vars.name: NANGO_SHAREPOINT_INTEGRATION_KEY
vars.label: SharePoint integration key
vars.help: The integration id set for this provider in the Nango dashboard. Leave empty to use the default.

vars.name: NANGO_ONEDRIVE_INTEGRATION_KEY
vars.label: OneDrive integration key
vars.help: The integration id set for this provider in the Nango dashboard. Leave empty to use the default.

vars.name: RAG_GROUNDEDNESS
vars.label: Groundedness scoring
vars.help: Scored by the sidecar after the stream ends; it does not delay the answer.

vars.name: RAG_GROUNDEDNESS_JUDGE_MODEL
vars.label: Judge model
vars.help: ⚠️ Answer sentences and the document passages sent with them go to this model’s provider. Choose a model from a different family than the answer model.

vars.name: RAG_GROUNDEDNESS_LLM_JUDGE
vars.label: Judge model for uncovered languages
vars.help: Off keeps “Not checked” for those languages.

vars.name: RAG_GROUNDEDNESS_VECTARA_MULTI_TENANT_ACK
vars.label: Multi-tenant Vectara acknowledgement
vars.help: ⚠️ Tick this only after the Vectara data-retention terms were recorded in live verification. Without it, multi-tenant deployments never send data to Vectara.

vars.name: RAG_GROUNDEDNESS_VECTARA_OPT_IN
vars.label: Vectara hosted scorer
vars.help: Sends the answer and its context to Vectara. Without it, only the local scorer runs.

vars.name: RAG_INGEST_PIPELINE
vars.label: Ingest pipeline
vars.help: legacy keeps the current document writers; unified uses the single ingest pipeline.

vars.name: RAG_INJECTION_CHECK
vars.label: Retrieval-time injection check
vars.help: flag records suspicious chunks; drop removes them and is the recommended mode; downweight only lowers their rank and is weaker than drop.

vars.name: RAG_INJECTION_LAKERA
vars.label: Lakera Guard hosted detector
vars.help: ⚠️ Sends chunk text to Lakera, a third party. Listed in the vendor inventory (ADM-04).

vars.name: RAG_INJECTION_LAKERA_MULTI_TENANT_ACK
vars.label: Multi-tenant Lakera acknowledgement
vars.help: ⚠️ Tick this only after the Lakera data-retention terms were recorded in live verification. Without it, multi-tenant deployments never send data to Lakera.

vars.name: RAG_INJECTION_PROMPT_GUARD
vars.label: Prompt Guard detector
vars.help: Optional model detector in the sidecar; English and Italian only.

vars.name: RAG_INJECTION_SCAN
vars.label: Prompt injection scan
vars.help: quarantine holds suspicious chunks back until an admin releases them.

vars.name: RAG_INVOICE_LLM_EXTRACT
vars.label: Model-assisted invoice extraction
vars.help: false uses rules only.

vars.name: RAG_LANG_CONFIDENCE
vars.label: Language confidence
vars.help: mapped keeps the three-value query language confidence (1, 0.5, empty); calibrated uses calibrated scores.

vars.name: RAG_LEXICAL_DICTIONARY
vars.label: Dictionary terms as single search terms

vars.name: RAG_LEXICAL_SCORING
vars.label: Lexical scoring
vars.help: ts_rank_cd keeps the current keyword ranking. bm25 ranks keyword matches by how rare each term is in this knowledge base and by text length. It needs RAG_LEXICAL_SEARCH on and statistics built with npm run rag:lexstats.

vars.name: RAG_LEXICAL_BM25_K1
vars.label: BM25 k1
vars.help: Term-frequency saturation, from 0.5 to 3. Used only with bm25.

vars.name: RAG_LEXICAL_BM25_B
vars.label: BM25 b
vars.help: Length normalisation, from 0 (none) to 1 (full). Used only with bm25.

vars.name: RAG_LEXICAL_DF_MODE
vars.label: BM25 document frequency
vars.help: Counts a duplicate cluster once in BM25 document frequency. Needs BM25 scoring and duplicate clusters.

vars.name: RAG_PARTIAL_ANSWER_RULE
vars.label: Partial answer rule
vars.help: Strict mode. Balanced mode labels anything that is not from the documents.

vars.name: RAG_PROMPT_BUDGET
vars.label: Prompt budget
vars.help: Fits documents and history into the model context window before the call.

vars.name: RAG_REGISTRY_TEXTS
vars.label: Language registry texts
vars.help: Off keeps today’s texts. English answers read the same either way. Needs supported languages.

vars.name: RAG_SECURITY_EVENTS
vars.label: Security events
vars.help: Stores ids only: no question, answer or document text.

vars.name: RAG_UPLOADER_ALERT_THRESHOLD
vars.label: Uploader alert threshold
vars.help: An alert opens above this number. 0 means no alerts.

vars.name: RAG_UPLOADER_HOLD
vars.label: Hold uploads of alerted uploaders
vars.help: Held uploads wait in Upload approvals. Documents that are already searchable are not touched.

vars.name: RAG_VERSION_LABELS
vars.label: Version labels
vars.help: Two versions that disagree are sent to Versions and dates for your decision. Apply the version-label migration first.

vars.name: RAG_RESULT_DIVERSITY
vars.label: Result diversity
vars.help: off keeps every result. collapse keeps the best passage of each duplicate cluster and lists the other documents under its citation. mmr does the same, then prefers passages that differ from each other.

vars.name: RAG_PARSE_POLL_BUDGET_MS
vars.label: Parse wait budget (ms)
vars.help: How long one request waits for a sidecar parse job, 1000 to 55000.

vars.name: RAG_PARSER
vars.label: Document parser
vars.help: llamaparse is the current parser; docling runs in the sidecar.

vars.name: RAG_PDF_IMAGE_CHUNKS
vars.label: PDF image chunks
vars.help: false keeps text chunks only.

vars.name: RAG_PIPELINE
vars.label: Retrieval pipeline
vars.help: legacy keeps the current retrieval path; v2 uses the Phase 4 staged pipeline (switches below).

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_CONDENSE
vars.description: Condense a multi-turn question into a standalone query (inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER is false)
vars.label: Condense follow-up questions

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_DATE_NORMALIZE
vars.description: Normalize relative dates in the query to absolute ranges (inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER is false)
vars.label: Normalize relative dates

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_DECOMPOSE
vars.description: Split compound questions into sub-queries (inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER is false)
vars.label: Decompose compound questions

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_EXPAND
vars.description: Add paraphrase variants of the query (inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER is false)
vars.label: Expand with paraphrases

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_FRAMEWORK
vars.description: Query-layer implementation: llamaindex (native port) or langchain
vars.label: Query-layer framework

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_HYDE
vars.description: Hypothetical-answer (HyDE) variant on the dense leg; off by default and never used in voice
vars.label: Hypothetical answer (HyDE) variant
vars.help: HyDE is off by default and is never used in voice.

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_LAYER
vars.description: Master switch for the Phase 6 query layer (rewrite gate and transforms); false keeps today's behaviour
vars.label: Query layer
vars.help: Off keeps the current retrieval path unchanged.

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_LLM_MODEL
vars.description: OpenRouter model used for query rewriting, expansion, decomposition and translation
vars.label: Query model

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_TRANSLATE
vars.description: Add a translated variant for cross-language retrieval (inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER is false)
vars.label: Translate for cross-language search

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_TRANSLATE_DISABLED_PROFILES
vars.description: Comma-separated embedding profiles for which the translate transform is skipped
vars.label: Profiles without translation
vars.help: Comma-separated embedding profiles that skip the translate transform; empty translates for every profile.

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_VOICE_TRANSFORMS
vars.description: Transforms allowed on the voice path: condense_history, normalize_dates, translate
vars.label: Voice transforms
vars.help: allowed: condense_history, normalize_dates, translate; voice always uses the native condense.

vars.name: RAG_QWEN_EMBED_FALLBACK
vars.label: Qwen embedding fallback host
vars.help: Used when the primary host is unavailable: openrouter tries the other host (DeepInfra when OpenRouter is primary and a DeepInfra key is set); none disables it.

vars.name: RAG_QWEN_EMBED_PRIMARY
vars.label: Qwen embedding primary host
vars.help: deepinfra needs the DeepInfra API key; openrouter needs only the OpenRouter API key.

vars.name: RAG_REFUSAL_FEEDBACK
vars.label: Refusal feedback
vars.help: Under an “information not available” or “knowledge base unavailable” message, the user can say whether an answer was expected. Needs the retrieval log on.

vars.name: RAG_REFUSAL_FLOOR
vars.label: Refusal floor
vars.help: Fallback used when no calibrated refusal threshold applies to a request

vars.name: RAG_RERANK_VOYAGE_MODEL_BY_LANG
vars.label: Voyage rerank model by language
vars.help: Per-language model override decided by eval, for example zh=rerank-2.5

vars.name: RAG_RETRIEVAL_LOG
vars.label: Retrieval log
vars.help: One row per chat, embed and voice retrieval, written after the response. Never stores answers, passage text or document names. Weekly mining needs the masked question. A workspace can lower its own level under RAG administration, Feedback loop.

vars.name: RAG_RETRIEVAL_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.label: Log retention (days)
vars.help: Rows older than this are deleted by mining, by Purge expired data and by the optional schedule. 1 to 365; any other value is read as 30.

vars.name: RAG_SEMANTIC_CACHE
vars.description: Semantic answer cache backend: off, pgvector or redisvl
vars.label: Semantic cache backend

vars.name: RAG_SEMANTIC_CACHE_EMBED_STORE
vars.description: Store embed-widget answers in the cache; false keeps embed check-only
vars.label: Store embed widget answers
vars.help: embed widget answers are only read from the cache unless this is on.

vars.name: RAG_SEMANTIC_CACHE_MAX_DISTANCE
vars.description: Maximum cosine distance for a cache hit
vars.label: Cache hit max distance

vars.name: RAG_SEMANTIC_CACHE_REFUSAL_TTL
vars.description: Lifetime of a cached refusal in seconds
vars.label: Cached refusal lifetime (seconds)

vars.name: RAG_SEMANTIC_CACHE_TTL
vars.description: Lifetime of a cached answer in seconds
vars.label: Cached answer lifetime (seconds)

vars.name: RAG_SOURCE_OPEN_SIGNAL
vars.label: Count opened sources
vars.help: Counts when a user opens a source or citation of their own answer. A weak signal: mining uses it only together with another one. Needs the retrieval log on.

vars.name: RAG_STAGE_TIMEOUTS
vars.label: Stage timeouts
vars.help: Per-stage time budgets in milliseconds; optional profile.stage=ms prefix (e.g. voice.rerank=200).

vars.name: RAG_TOOL_RESULT_GUARD
vars.label: Tool result guard
vars.help: tag wraps web search and MCP results as untrusted data for the model; tag_and_flag also runs the injection check on them.

vars.name: REDIS_URL
vars.description: RedisVL connection URL for the semantic cache; read by the sidecar only, never by the app
vars.label: Redis URL
vars.help: Used by the sidecar for the redisvl backend. Stays on the server; only its presence is reported.

vars.name: VOICE_MAX_ACTIVE_ROOMS
vars.label: Max concurrent voice rooms
vars.help: Must equal VOICE_AGENT_MAX_SESSIONS on the voice agent

vars.name: RAG_RETRIEVAL_BACKEND
vars.label: Chat retrieval backend
vars.help: Backend for chat and embedded chat retrieval.

vars.name: RAG_RETRIEVAL_BACKEND_VOICE
vars.label: Voice retrieval backend
vars.help: Set separately from chat; voice has a lower latency budget.

vars.name: RAG_OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_VIA
vars.description: Host for the OpenAI embedding model: openai or openrouter (same model, same vectors; no Batch API through OpenRouter)
vars.label: OpenAI embedding host
vars.help: openrouter sends the same embedding model through OpenRouter with the OpenRouter API key (same vectors, no re-embed); the OpenAI Batch API is then unavailable and backfills embed immediately.

vars.name: RAG_ATTRIBUTE_FILTER
vars.label: Attribute filter
vars.help: off ignores attributes. hard limits retrieval to the documents whose attributes match a value named in the question or sent with the request, and searches again without the limit when that finds nothing. soft keeps every document and ranks the matching ones higher. Needs document attributes and the v2 pipeline.

vars.name: RAG_LEXICAL_QUANTITY
vars.label: Numbers with units as single search terms

vars.name: RAG_CONFIG_GATE
vars.description: Pre-save setting check in the Config UI: off | warn | enforce (off saves at once, as before).
vars.label: Setting check before save

vars.name: RAG_CONFIG_GATE_LIVE
vars.description: Adds a live chat-model layer to the setting check; no effect while RAG_CONFIG_GATE=off.
vars.label: Live layer of the setting check

vars.name: RAG_MONITOR
vars.description: Daily monitor over the retrieval log; off runs nothing, stores nothing and its routes answer 404.
vars.label: Daily monitor

vars.name: RAG_MONITOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for monitor webhook deliveries, at least 32 characters.
vars.label: Monitor webhook signing secret

vars.name: RAG_MONITOR_WEBHOOK_URL
vars.description: Optional https:// admin webhook for monitor alerts; treated as a secret, never shown or logged.
vars.label: Monitor webhook URL

vars.name: RAG_REPRESENTATIVE_SAMPLE
vars.description: Weekly representative sample of real questions into the review queue; needs masked_query logging and expert review.
vars.label: Representative sample

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_HISTORY_FALLBACK
vars.description: Adds a history_fallback variant (previous question plus follow-up) when condense was skipped; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: History fallback variant

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_DECOMPOSE_COMPLETENESS
vars.description: Checks that decomposed sub-questions cover every protected token of the question; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Sub-question completeness check

vars.name: RAG_QUERY_SUBQ_FILTERS
vars.description: Lets each sub-question narrow its own search with filters that can only narrow the tenant scope; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Sub-question filters

vars.name: RAG_DECOMPOSED_ANSWER
vars.description: Answers a decomposed question in one part per sub-question, each with its own citations; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Answer per sub-question

vars.name: RAG_TRANSLATION_GLOSSARY
vars.description: Enforces the translation glossary in query translation, document translation and rewriting; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Translation glossary

vars.name: RAG_LANGID_SIDECAR
vars.description: Asks the sidecar language detector about short or mixed-script questions the built-in detector is unsure of; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Sidecar language detector

vars.name: RAG_MODEL_ROUTING
vars.description: Routing for the Auto model entry: off sends Auto to the quality model, auto routes simple lookups to the fast model; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Auto model routing
vars.help: Off sends the Auto model entry to the quality model; auto routes simple lookups to the fast model.

vars.name: RAG_ROUTING_FAST_MODEL
vars.description: Fast model id for Auto routing; must be listed in the OpenRouter model list and not be auto
vars.label: Routing fast model
vars.help: Must be listed in the OpenRouter model list and must not be auto.

vars.name: RAG_ROUTING_QUALITY_MODEL
vars.description: Quality model id for Auto routing; must be listed in the OpenRouter model list and not be auto
vars.label: Routing quality model
vars.help: Must be listed in the OpenRouter model list and must not be auto.

vars.name: RAG_SPECULATIVE_RETRIEVAL
vars.description: Starts embedding and search of the original question while the transforms run; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Speculative retrieval

vars.name: RAG_WHATSAPP_HISTORY
vars.description: Sends recent turns of the same WhatsApp sender and session with each message; applies to the WhatsApp channel itself
vars.label: WhatsApp conversation history

vars.name: RAG_SCOPE_GATE
vars.description: Skips retrieval for questions clearly outside the workspace's own documents; inert while RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false
vars.label: Scope gate
